quote: Calling a Flow operator function within composition will result in a new Flow being created every recomposition,
note: launch 在組建期:lint 頁講協程在組合失敗仍會建立、須改 LaunchedEffect;Flow 運算子:每次重組新 Flow 並重置 collectAsState,須放 remember 或 effect。標準寫法與後果皆吻合。

quote: Variables used in an effect should be added as a parameter of the effect composable, or use `rememberUpdatedState`.
note: 官方 Restarting effects 節與 rememberUpdatedState 範例(onTimeout)吻合。pointerInput 沒有專頁明講,但同一規則適用。

quote: Calling StateFlow.value within composition will not observe changes to the StateFlow,
note: lint 頁說明讀 value 不訂閱、改用 collectAsState;state 頁稱 collectAsStateWithLifecycle 為 Android 上建議的收集 API。

quote: If the lambda never assigns (i.e `value = foo`), then the State will never change.
note: 與型錄壞寫法、後果一致。

quote: In order to launch a coroutine outside of a composable, but scoped so that it will be automatically canceled once it leaves the composition, use
note: 官方範例把 rememberCoroutineScope 的 launch 放在 onClick 事件回呼,初始化載入用 LaunchedEffect。SC COMPOSE_002 規則本身未查。

quote: it is incorrect to perform an effect before a successful recomposition is guaranteed, which is the case when writing the effect directly in a composable.
note: SideEffect 段原文,並稱 composables should ideally be side-effect free。

quote: Calling Lifecycle.currentState within composition will not observe changes to the Lifecycle,
note: 壞寫法與後果吻合;currentStateAsState 標準寫法頁面片段未見逐字,但核心成立。

quote: Failing to call collect will cause all code in the block to run when the gesture is started.
note: 後果表述略異(整段在手勢開始時就執行),與型錄『動畫與完成判定失效』方向一致、不相反。

quote: To solve this problem, you should inject these dependencies as default values in the composable function.
note: compose-rules 的 Make dependencies explicit 節支持預設參數注入;頁面未明講『僅畫面層』,該部分為型錄延伸,核心主張吻合。

quote: Prefer passing immutable values for state and event handler lambdas.
note: compose-rules:Do not pass ViewModels (or objects from DI) down;官方架構頁講傳狀態與事件 lambda 的好處(可重用、可驗證)。

quote: View models should not be constructed directly inside composable functions.
note: 標準寫法 viewModel() 吻合;hiltViewModel() 未於該頁出現但屬同類。

quote: results in a state implementation that requires all state values to be boxed.
note: 吻合,另稱每次寫入多一次配置。

quote: Writes to mutable collections inside a MutableState will not cause a recomposition
note: 標準寫法(唯讀集合整份替換或 SnapshotStateList)與官方 state 頁 Caution 一致。

quote: Instead, use `SideEffect` to make deferred changes once the composition succeeds,
note: 原文建議 SideEffect 或直接改 MutableState;型錄另列 LaunchedEffect 為替代,未相反。

quote: If you don't `remember` the state instance, a new state instance will be created when the function is recomposed.
note: lint 頁:state 物件須 remember 否則重組時重建並遺失狀態。待查項(derivedStateOf、LazyListState 是否被規則涵蓋)本次未驗,只驗核心主張。

quote: The methods used to create movable composable content need to be used inside a `remember` function.
note: 吻合。

quote: Always pass any inputs referenced inside the `remember` calculation block as keys so the cached value updates when those inputs change.
note: 官方原文直接支持,並有 remember(contacts, comparator) 範例。

quote: Every time `ContactsList` is recomposed, the entire contact list is sorted all over again, even though the list hasn't changed.
note: 官方以 items(contacts.sortedWith(...)) 標為 DON'T DO THIS,改 remember 或移到 ViewModel,完全吻合。

quote: The problem here is, if the user scrolls the list, `listState` is constantly changing as the user drags their finger.
note: 官方以 firstVisibleItemIndex > 0 為例,解法 derivedStateOf 或 lambda 版 modifier,吻合。注意官方新版另提 computedStateOf(Compose 1.13+)。

quote: However, this is purely overhead and not required, as shown in the following snippet:
note: 官方 Incorrect usage 範例即 "$firstName $lastName" 包 derivedStateOf,與型錄逐字相同。

quote: Calling these functions does not read observable state and will not be updated if the user changes the locale.
note: 壞寫法與後果吻合;但官方建議的標準寫法是 LocalLocale.current.platformLocale,與型錄的 LocalConfiguration.current.locales[0] 不同(不算相反),建議型錄更新。

quote: so you may end up with stale values when the Configuration changes.
note: 吻合;資源讀取兩條規則未逐頁驗。

quote: Instead it is recommended to use WindowInfo.containerSize which accurately represents the window size.
note: 原文理由是 insets 行為依 targetSdk 而異且四捨五入,與型錄後果(多視窗摺疊機尺寸錯)方向相近但措辭不同。

quote: Casting Context to Activity is an error as Contexts are not always Activities. Use LocalActivity instead.
note: 吻合。

quote: When a component accepts MutableState as a parameter, it gains the ability to change it.
note: 標準寫法 value + onValueChange 見官方 state hoisting 節。

quote: It is very easy to use a mutable object which does not trigger recomposition.
note: 原文舉 ArrayList 與 ViewModel;頁面未提 MutableList 字面,屬同類。

quote: However, composables with internal state tend to be less reusable and harder to test.
note: 官方 Stateful versus stateless 節:同時提供 stateful 與 stateless 版本,與型錄標準寫法一致。

quote: By moving state instead of duplicating it, we're ensuring there's only one source of truth.
note: 官方講單一真相來源原則,支持核心主張;remember(param){mutableStateOf(param)} 的具體寫法頁面未直接示範。

quote: You can avoid backwards writes altogether by never writing to state in Composition.
note: 官方 Avoid backwards writes 節,範例即 count++,後果為無限重組,吻合。

quote: Using `Unit` as a key should be done infrequently, and should always be done explicitly by passing the `Unit` literal.
note: 原文重點是易誤用與可讀性,未明講『效應永不重啟』,屬型錄推論,不相反。

quote: Having an empty block in `onDispose` is not a good practice.
note: 官方範例 onDispose 內 removeObserver,吻合;洩漏後果為合理推論。
